one_liner: Watchlist civic-letter workflow; prove identity, demand, local coverage, and delivery before pitching.
thesis: US residents will pay $5, $15, or $25 per civic letter campaign if research, targeting, citation verification, drafting, payment, and delivery are reliable [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts; BUSINESS.md].
verdict: Conditional research asset, not investible business yet [evidence: dispatch registry notes].

evidenceStrength.productImplementation: Medium: API, worker, web, Prisma, and tests exist [evidence: apps; packages; tests].
evidenceStrength.marketDemand: Low: no workspace evidence of paid users or revenue [evidence: current repo state].
evidenceStrength.deliveryCoverage: Low-to-medium: delivery controls exist, but local official lookup is stubbed [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts; apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts].
evidenceStrength.financialModel: Low: planning model only, with $9,000, $28,800, and $86,400 annual scenarios [assumption: BUSINESS.md arithmetic model].

mustValidate: Operator confirms whether `brooks-history` should pitch CivicState.
Federal/state coverage reaches 95% and local coverage reaches 60%, or launch scope narrows [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
WrkPlug posture is resolved against direct Clerk/Stripe implementation [evidence: apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts; apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts].
antiThesis: Consumer willingness to pay may be too low even at $5 [assumption: no paid-user evidence].
The local civic use case may fail until local official data is implemented [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts].
The moat is weak before volume [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
Legal-adjacent and deliverability risks may dominate the economics [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].
